$description: Ember Glass, the look of the Phoenix UI layer for webOS Phoenix 2.0. Read off the mock-ups: docs/design-2.0/directions/ember-glass/assets/base.css and SPEC.md in webos-phoenix. Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG 2025.10). Themed tokens live under theme.light and theme.dark, which have the same shape.

sans.$description: Manrope (SIL OFL 1.1), variable 200-800; Open Sans as the fallback. The font is an open owner question (Q119): docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

numeral-unit.$description: The unit after a big number (%)

tab.$description: Tabs (components.html .tabs > div; Manrope's normal line height, 19 px)

banner-title.$description: A notification's sender (components.html .banner .t; 21 px, the normal line height)

badge.$description: An unread count (messaging-list.html .conv .n; the normal line height, 15 px, centred in its pill)

chip.$description: A chip: one of a person's accounts (messaging-thread.html .idp)

screen-padding-x.$description: A screen's side margin to its planes

fade-bottom.$description: A scrolling screen fades out over its last 70 px

card.$description: The card (the app's window in the card view)

menu-corner.$description: The app menu's square-ish corner under the tab

hairline.$description: One device pixel and a bit at 2.5x; drawn as an inset box-shadow

glow.$description: The ember's light; glows use it at .35 to .8

gradient.$description: The ember: focus, the active item, the Assistant

fill.$description: Filled controls carrying a white glyph (3:1 or more)

orb.$description: The Assistant's orb: a lit ember sphere

glass.$description: The four glass levels (SPEC.md, "Glass tokens"). Blur radii here; tints and tone maps per theme.

blur.$description: L1, the card: the shell blurs the wallpaper once (docs/SHELL-CONTRACT.md)
L3, floats (toolbars, the compose bar): live backdrop blur
L4, overlays (menus, banners, dialogs): live backdrop blur

range-head.$description: The playback head's ring and glow (music.html .prog .head)

breathe.$description: The gesture light breathes while you gesture

row-inset.$description: Where a row's separator starts (under the text)

toggle-border.$description: The off toggle's boundary (ink-3, 3:1 or more)

gesture-strip.$description: The shell's gesture strip under the card

check-icon.$description: The tick in a checked box

radio-dot-inset.$description: The checked radio's dot: the box less this all round

active-bar.$description: The ember bar beside the active item (base.css .active-bar)

presence.$description: The presence dot on an avatar

presence-ring.$description: The gap drawn around it, in the colour under the avatar

gesture-light.$description: Onyx Reborn's long, fading bar lit gold to ember (SPEC.md, "The gesture light"; Onyx Reborn onyx.css:105)

gradient.$description: Gold-white at the centre, through gold and ember to nothing at both ends

glow.$description: A drop shadow that follows the gradient's alpha (CSS filter: drop-shadow)

slider.$description: Enyo 2's slider (onyx.Grabber) at the bottom left of each tablet column, redrawn: three hairline bars (SPEC.md, "The slider")

range.$description: The value slider: a hairline, the ember on the part that is set

head.$description: A playback position's head, without a knob (music.html .prog .head)

avatar.$description: Synergy's merged person: one arc per linked account around the avatar (app.js ring())

ring-inset.$description: The ring lies this far outside the avatar

ring-radius.$description: In a 100-unit box over the avatar and its inset

ring-start.$description: Degrees clockwise from the top where the first arc starts (after half a gap)

columns.$description: ColumnPanels: the TouchPad's sliding columns (Enyo 2 layout/panels CollapsingArranger) on a tablet, one at a time on a phone

narrow-width.$description: Below this a window is laid out as a phone's: one column at a time

toolbar-inset.$description: A bare column's toolbar starts this far in (email.html .coltb.bare)

drag-threshold.$description: A drag that ends past this share of the way slides on; less slides back

fling-velocity.$description: px per ms: a faster release slides on in its direction, however far it went

theme.$description: Light ("porcelain") and dark ("graphite"). Both groups have the same tokens.

bg.$description: Under the glass when the shell gives no wallpaper

ink-3.$description: One step stronger than Ember's, to keep 4.5:1 on the glass

inverse.$description: The primary fill (ink pills, the on toggle)

on-danger.$description: Text on a solid danger pill

ambient.$description: Ember's light on the L1 tint: white from the top left (light); the ember glow from below (dark)

saturate.$description: The tone map applied to the blurred wallpaper

contrast.$description: Light glass over a dark wallpaper needs contrast down and brightness up, or it reads grey

tint.$description: Planes: tint only, no second blur

contrast.$description: Light overlays tone-map a dark backdrop too

highlight.$description: The 1 px top highlight on every glass surface

fallback.$description: L3 and L4 with no live blur (low end, prefers-reduced-transparency, blur none)

lift.$description: A plane: the top highlight and a long warm shadow

card.$description: The card over the wallpaper (the shell draws it)

pill-sheen.$description: The top of a pill's vertical sheen
